answer: Honeypot challenge auditing resists sybils: the auditor plants decoy answers that look valid but are known-bad, indistinguishable from real ones without the private anchor key. A grader or identity that approves a honeypot reveals it is rubber-stamping, not truly evaluating — the quartz-clear tell of a bot or colluding ring — and is slashed. Because decoys are unpredictable and keyed to hidden state, a farm cannot filter them: any fake that forges approvals wholesale eventually certifies a planted trap. Honest graders anchor on real judgment; a swarm cannot cheaply tell honeypot from genuine.
